cover_tagline: Light, air and green space, a short walk from the metro.
overview_headline: Homes designed around light and open space
overview_intro: Aurelia Heights is a pair of residential towers in Pune with 2 and 3 BHK homes. The towers stand around a landscaped podium garden, and the plans put living rooms and bedrooms on the sides with the most daylight. The metro station, schools and a hospital are close by, so the daily routine stays short.
overview_highlights:
Two towers of 2 and 3 BHK homes
Landscaped podium garden
Short walk to the metro
Schools and a hospital nearby
amenities_blurb: From the infinity pool to the co-working lounge, every amenity is planned for daily use rather than for show.
plan_note: Areas shown are carpet areas. Furniture in the plans is indicative only.
about_headline: Building homes in Pune for over fifteen years
